article_title: Introducing particle physics concepts through visual art
citation: I. Andrews, K. Nikolopoulos. (2018). Introducing particle physics concepts through visual art. https://arxiv.org/abs/1806.11490
title: A1-sized ideas sheet accumulating workshop outcomes with scientific annotations
description: The ideas sheet is a single A1-sized sheet on which the outcomes of all workshop activities are placed and progressively annotated. The article reports that "the placing of the outcomes onto a single A1-sized 'ideas' sheet leads the pupils to take greater ownership of the developing product, which is further enhanced by the annotation of the outcome with scientific explanations." Conveying concepts briefly in the students' own words offers another learning opportunity, and the sheet becomes the focus of group critiques during the workshop.
requirements: An A1-sized sheet per group, maintained throughout the day, with annotations written by students in their own words
target_learners: Key Stage 4 students aged 14 to 16 in the British education system
target_learning_goals: Taking ownership of the developing product and briefly conveying scientific concepts in students' own words
examples: Examples of developing ideas sheets are shown in Fig. 2, and completed sheets were reviewed in critiques and exhibited at the final group critique
key_sources: I. Andrews, K. Nikolopoulos. (2018). Introducing particle physics concepts through visual art. https://arxiv.org/abs/1806.11490
